title: Answers to the Three Questions
summary: Work through Answers to the Three Questions.

blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Answers to the Three Questions**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § Answers to the Three Questions
blocks.md: Every mechanism in the book now carries a price in one unit, the cost per accepted task of each lighthouse (a later section). With that unit, the three architectural questions posed in the introduction, each answered in part by every later chapter, can be answered concisely. Each answer is a design claim that one live workload can test.

points: You have worked through Answers to the Three Questions.
